card.name: Cycle counts and time points
card.fires_on: The number just before the word "cycles" in chemotherapy schedules, and the word "time" before "point". Also fires on "Mult" in "Multidimensional".

modes.label: Number of cycles
modes.description: A digit giving how many treatment cycles, right after "for" or "up to".
modes.example: every 3 weeks for up to <<4>> cycles prior to surgery.

modes.label: Time point
modes.description: The word "time" just before "point" or "-point" in measurement timing.
